ev_0006.summary: Circle O center (539,104) r~75.6 with B on the upper-left at (470,134) and D at the bottom (539,179). Baseline A(65,321)-C(539,321)-E(633,321) is solid. DC is a solid vertical from D to C with a verified right-angle mark at C (detect_right_angle_marker, right_angle_01). DE is solid from D to E. OB and OD are dashed radii. CV geometry contradicts the supervisor's tangency claim: the line AB passes within ~2 px of O, so AB and OB are collinear (AB is a secant through the centre, not tangent); AB is therefore not perpendicular to OB. Style analysis returned no segment results, so line styles come from the CV detect_lines dash metrics and the supervisor.
